description:
Read one marketplace match by id, including its `escrow_terms` and this trade's typed fee/timeout
    fields. You must be a party to the match. Bearer required. `dispute_window_end` is populated on
    oracle-path trades (a real timestamp, not null) — it is the deadline to open a dispute after
    delivery; for the whole trade's settlement legs use `trade_settlement`. Once disputed:
    `dispute_deadline` (when an unresolved dispute auto-refunds the buyer — 30 days from the dispute, or the
    later date BOTH parties agreed), `dispute_extended_until`, `dispute_extension_agreed`,
    `dispute_extension_state` (none | offer_pending | agreed | agreed_new_offer_pending) and a pending offer in
    `dispute_extension_proposed_by`/`_until`. Both parties extend it by each sending POST
    /api/v1/marketplace/match/{id}/extend-dispute with the same JSON body {"until": "<ISO 8601 time with a
    timezone>"}; until must be after the current dispute deadline and at most 90 days after the dispute opened.

match_id.description: The marketplace match id (UUID). You must be a party to it.
